Feiruz

Biography

Feiruz is a thief who helps Kir conceal his conspicuous face beneath a cloth, using fear of disease as a disguise. Later he asks for help rescuing his fiancée Aliya from prison. He dies during the escape, leaving Aliya grieving and determined to retaliate. [1, 2, 3]
